broadcasts.message: normalize.js remains unchanged for round 3. It fully satisfies the spec: NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to single ASCII space, trim. No extra transformations that could affect meaning. Ready for final round.

tokenizer.js final: calls injected normalize(text) once, extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes via regex, preserves order, no stopwords, negation preserved. No changes from prior rounds. Ready for final integration.
Pipeline final and unchanged. Uses Object.create(null) for prototype-safe frequencies. Ready for final integration.
